system.description:
When you deal damage with a Focused Attack from your Soul Armament a small soul Shard will embed itself within the target. Up to 5 shards can exist at once within a creature. For every shard a creature has, you gain a +1 to Attack Rolls against them.

You can choose to fire a Shard into an unoccupied space within a number of Spaces equal to your Soul as a 1 Stamina Swift Action, creating a Buried Shard which can be used with other Precision Skills.

Creatures can forcibly rip a shard loose as a Swift Action for the cost of 1 Stamina and 1 Health per Shard.
